recreation_brief:
1. Set a white (#FFFFFF) slide background; use one sans-serif font family throughout.
2. Place the title at top center (vertical band ~5–15% of slide height): bold text 'Classification Example' with 'Classification' in blue #0000CC and 'Example' in red #FF0000; this is the largest text on the slide.
3. Place the slide-number badge in the top-right corner: a filled yellow (#FFFF99) circle containing '32' in black (#000000).
4. Draw the left diagram container: a rectangle with a red (#FF0000) border and white/transparent fill, spanning x ≈5–45% and y ≈18–95% of the slide.
5. Inside the left container, draw a 3D coordinate system: 3 red (#FF0000) arrowed axes — vertical axis labeled 'y', lower-left axis labeled 'x1', right axis labeled 'x2' — with tick labels '1' and '2' on the x1 axis and '1' and '2' on the x2 axis.
6. Inside the left container, draw the hyperplane as a yellow (#FFFF99) tilted parallelogram between the axes; label it 'W' in black (#000000) with an underline.
7. Inside the left container, place 4 small data-point dots on the yellow plane, colored blue (#0000FF) and orange/brown (#CC7722); per-dot color assignment is unspecified (see validation.uncertain_items).
8. Inside the left container, draw 1 red (#FF0000) arrow pointing into the plane; place the text '-ve ( < 0 )' in red (#FF0000) above the plane and '+ve ( > 0 )' in blue (#0000FF) below-left of the plane.
9. Draw the upper-right container: a rectangle with a gray (#808080) border and white/transparent fill, spanning x ≈45–90% and y ≈18–55% of the slide.
10. Inside the upper-right container, build the data table: 2 blue (#0000FF) row labels 'x1 ⇒' and 'x2 ⇒' on the left, and 4 column vectors to their right — X1 = (1, 1)^T, X2 = (2, 2)^T, X3 = (2, 1)^T, X4 = (1, 2)^T — in black (#000000).
11. Directly beneath the 4 vectors, place the class labels: 'y1 = C1' in red (#FF0000), 'y2 = C2' in blue (#0000FF), 'y3 = C1' in red (#FF0000), 'y4 = C2' in blue (#0000FF).
12. Below the table, place 'Classify' in green (#009900) italic followed by 'X = (7, 3)^T' in blue (#0000FF), then the text 'y = C1 or C2 ???' with 'C1' in red (#FF0000) and 'C2' in blue (#0000FF).
13. Draw the lower-right container: a light-green (#E8F5E9) filled rectangle spanning x ≈47–88% and y ≈58–88% of the slide; at its top place the header 'Required to obtain W that satisfies' in black (#000000) with the 'W' in red (#FF0000) and underlined.
14. Inside the lower-right container, place the matrix equation: 4 blue (#0000FF) row labels 'x1 ⇒', 'x2 ⇒', 'x3 ⇒', 'x4 ⇒' on the left; a 4×3 matrix in red (#FF0000) with rows (1 1 1), (1 2 2), (1 2 1), (1 1 2); multiplied by a red (#FF0000) vector 'W' in parentheses; then an equals sign and a red (#FF0000) 4-entry column vector reading '> 0', '< 0', '> 0', '< 0' top to bottom.
15. Place the footer box at bottom center-right (y ≈92–100% of slide height): a beige (#F5F5DC) filled rectangle with bold text 'How to deal “Mathematically” with “<” and “>” ???' — 'Mathematically' in red (#FF0000), the rest in black (#000000).
